text:
Hi, Bluesky. EZG Studio is an independent studio working at the intersection of software and fabrication: native iOS apps, laser-cut and 3D-printed objects, and digital design assets.

First up: Situ and Folio, both on the App Store now.

card.title: EZG Studio
card.description: Native iOS apps, laser-cut and 3D-printed objects, and digital design assets.

text:
Situ is a field guide to the built world: 1,000+ architectural landmarks on a map, each with its architect, year, style and the story behind the façade.

No account. No ads. No tracking.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/situ-architecture-map/id6829291538

#architecture

images.alt: Situ app shown on iPhone with a map of architectural landmarks.

text:
Record Store Day Black Friday. Whatever you bring home today, Folio gives it a proper place on the shelf: catalog records, track condition and value, and keep a wishlist of what you're still hunting.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/folio-collection-tracker/id6811679127

#vinyl

images.alt: Folio app screens showing a cataloged collection.

text:
Your collection deserves better than a spreadsheet. Folio has six hand-crafted themes: Brutalist, Cartoon, Glass, Illustrative, Neumorphic and Riso. Each one restyles the whole app, down to the icon.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/folio-collection-tracker/id6811679127

images.alt: Folio's theme picker showing six visual styles.

text:
Every site in Situ is a category pin, from row houses to memorials. Tap one and it reads like a museum label for the building in front of you.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/situ-architecture-map/id6829291538

#architecture #design

images.alt: Situ's map view with category pins for nearby landmarks.

text:
Coming soon: Fora, a guide to the drives worth taking slowly and the third places worth stopping for. Cafés, bookshops, farm stands, record shops and diners along the way.

The long way is the point.

card.title: Fora — Take the long way
card.description: Scenic drives and third places, coming to iOS.
